system.description:
You are able to equip [Blade]. This skill is only effective when you are equipped with [Blade] in a [Hand Slot]. You can also equip a [Magic Stone] in a [Hand Slot]. 

(SR2): Your [Evasion] and [Resistance] is increased by +1. 

(SR3): Your [Physical Defense] is increased by + (INT Mod).

A battle style that combines magic stones with a sword instead of a staff to activate magic. If you master it, you can acquire the power of defense that can stand on the front line even though it is a magic attack class.
